releases.title: Client update after Stop; stop/start audit
notes: Apply no longer stops the node — Stop first, then update, then Restart.
Stop and Restart write each step to /var/log/rpcnode.log (cli stop, systemctl stop/start).

releases.title: Client update stops; start is manual
notes: Apply is allowed while the node is stopped.
Update soft-stops, replaces the client, and stays down. Restart starts the new binary.

releases.title: Client update steps in host audit log
notes: Apply wrote only UI state «starting client update» — /var/log/rpcnode.log stayed empty.
Each step now hostLog: accepted, catalog, RPC sleep, soft-stop, install, start, done/error. Same for Restart / Stop.

releases.title: Soft-stop fullnode from the node page
notes: Stop next to Restart: same graceful stop (CLI / ExecStop / SIGTERM), unit stays down until Restart.
Public Go RPC sleeps (503) while stopped. Chain data is not wiped.

releases.title: Client update apply for all catalog networks
notes: Check already worked everywhere; Apply was hard-coded to TRON (and briefly BSC).
Apply is now the same pipeline on every leaf: soft-stop (CLI/RPC then systemctl), download the catalog artifact (jar / bin / tarball), start the same units.
Apt / docker_extract / empty artifact_url stay an honest error — there is nothing to replace.

releases.title: TON getVersion + install CDN host
notes: Admin/node version check was status=unsupported — toncenter HTTP API has no version method.
Public Go RPC now answers version / getVersion / getNodeVersion with the same client_version as the panel (validator-engine --version).
Bare POST / is rewritten to /api/v2/jsonRPC so the public base URL works as a TON JSON-RPC endpoint.
Update no longer fetches rpcnode.dev/install (404). Channel is toolkit.rpcnode.dev; old env/unit URLs are rewritten.

releases.title: TON dump apply — stop killing validator at 99%
notes: After a MyTonCtrl dump, seqno stayed 0 and the bar sat at 99% «applying state» for a day (testnet and mainnet).
MyTonCtrl rewrites validator ExecStart; heal no longer SIGKILL-recycles while apply is running.
After OOM or a restart, celldb cache is capped to 1G and MemoryMax=85%.
Sync shows restart / apply OOM instead of a fake «applying» line.

releases.title: Cardano Mithril snapshot + XRPL history picker
notes: Cardano Snapshot step downloads official Mithril latest (include-ancillary), mithril-client 2630.0.
Honest snapshot % from N/7 files and MiB in the log.
XRPL install picker: stock / 1 day / 2 weeks / full history (default weeks).

releases.title: TRON mainnet snapshot flavors
notes: Install picker: standard / internal_tx / balance_history — matching official LevelDB mirrors and HOCON.
Choice is persisted on the panel and on the host; re-add from awaiting_ports clears it.

releases.title: XRPL provision compile
notes: ensureXRPLDInstalled takes the environment so panel Docker builds again.

releases.title: XRPL client pin 3.3.0
notes: catalog.json pins xrpld 3.3.0. Empty version + unpinned apt was installing 3.2.0.

releases.title: XRPL first ledger + hub peers
notes: seq=0 with overlay flap and 0–2 peers now pins official hubs in ips_fixed.
LoadManager stall recycles at medium node size.

releases.title: XRPL dead server_stop is not a start fault
notes: no response from server / ExecMainCode=1 during ExecStop on a dead xrpld is ignored; the unit is started.

releases.title: TON OOM after dump is not Synced
notes: seqno=0 after dump is apply/OOM, not tip — no 99.9% / 0.1% lag-closed bounce.
Cap --celldb-cache-size from RAM; strip preload-all / in-memory / fast-state-serializer.

releases.title: Ethereum tip after sync
notes: Public tip shows blocks / headers after sync. eth_syncing=false has no highestBlock.

releases.title: XRPL history peers
notes: peers_max=100, official hubs, ips_fixed s2.ripple.com. Heal on start.
No official snapshot — full history is still a long peer backfill.

releases.title: Synced means tip and history proof
notes: Live tip alone is not Synced. XRPL complete_ledgers, Stellar oldestLedger, Bitcoin-family not pruned.
UI and panel require verification_pct ≥ 99.9.

releases.title: XRPL false Synced
notes: server_state=full on a short complete_ledgers window is live tip, not history.
Synced only when complete_ledgers reaches genesis (32570) and the tip.

releases.title: XRPL Sync bar from complete_ledgers
notes: verification_pct from complete_ledgers high / tip. No official tarball (~39 TiB via peers).

releases.title: Port holder + Kill
notes: Check ports shows the program holding a catalog port. Kill (with confirm) goes through the tip agent.

releases.title: Check ports does not parse ufw
notes: Reach is a panel dial to the Server public IP. The agent never runs ufw allow / deny.

releases.title: Outbound reach on public / agent / p2p
notes: Check ports: panel dials the Server public IP while the tip holds a nonce listener. reach = reachable or filtered.

releases.title: Host audit log
notes: /var/log/rpcnode.log is discrete hostLog ops only (update, provision, start, snapshot, errors). Agent stdout stays per-unit.

releases.title: TRON Java 8
notes: ensureJava8 checks java -version. Missing or wrong Java → apt openjdk-8-jre-headless, else Temurin 8.
Unit ExecStart is pinned to Java 8 so a host default of 17 does not crash GreatVoyage.

releases.title: Sepolia L1 RPC for Orbit / OP-stack
notes: Parent-chain default is publicnode ethereum-sepolia. Mainnet L1 stays on the host ethereum port.
Override with RPCNODE_L1_RPC_URL.

releases.title: Optimism sepolia + Bitcoin Core 28.1
notes: Optimism sepolia provision (was a mainnet-only stub). Bitcoin Core default 28.1 for testnet4.

releases.title: Base sepolia JWT, BSC cache, Arb sepolia
notes: Write JWT before waiting on authrpc. Sepolia parent-chain uses sepolia L1.
BSC --cache capped to ~25% RAM. Arb sepolia provision added.

releases.title: Host OS deps on provision and start
notes: The agent apt-installs what the network needs. TRON Java 8 is no longer a manual SSH step.
